propositions: 836 truncated bridge-echo comments without reconciler marker exist across three Jira issues (REB-1567, REB-1931, REB-2605) because truncation removes the marker appended after the body
Comments are deletion candidates if they contain the truncation suffix AND lack the reconciler marker; the original identification rule requiring rendered length of 32767 was incorrect and replaced
For each distinct normalized comment body, the oldest copy (lowest Jira comment id) must be retained to preserve one survivor per duplicate set
After bridge re-enablement, the keep-one rule must invert to preserve the newest copy whose id is recorded in comment_ids, else the primary skip orphans and re-creates the original defect
Phase 2 deletion removed 827 comments across the three issues with zero data loss, verified by reconciliation: backup - deleted = observed (145→7, 298→22, 430→16)
A final sweep is required after the first post-re-enable bridge pass to clean the ~8 newly-posted copies, with inverted keep-one logic reading from current bindings.json
